    AI Overview
    Bill Murray supports the UConn Huskies basketball team primarily because his son, Luke Murray, serves as an assistant coach for the program. The 75-year-old actor has become a familiar fixture in the stands since 2021, showing support for his son’s professional accomplishments and celebrating with the team during their championship runs. 
    • Support for his son: Luke Murray has been a key member of Dan Hurley's staff since 2021, and Bill frequently attends games to show pride, according to Fox News and Instagram.
    • A "Dad" First: Despite being a native of Chicago and a fan of the Illinois Fighting Illini, Bill sets aside his hometown loyalty to support Luke’s team, reports Yahoo Sports
      .
    • Final Four Presence: Murray is often seen in the stands, including at the 2026 Final Four in Indianapolis, notes bleacherreport and Instagram. 
    Although Luke Murray is expected to take a new job at Boston College after the 2026 season, Bill has solidified his role as a passionate "ultimate sports dad" for the Huskies, notes Heavy.com and For The Win.
